source: real exports: Control Plane run record and proposal from the Control Plane's own flow helpers (setup_flow, operation-identity enable) driven through the runtime's own executors, then export_execution_artifacts; synthetic data, throwaway stores, nothing hand-edited

producer.note: runtime main after R2 (#112, optional operation key on the atomic route); control plane main after J3 (#56)

script: capture_paired.py (PYTHONPATH=src:.:<runtime checkout> python capture_paired.py <out-dir> <runtime-revision>, from the control plane checkout)

scenarios.atomic-operation-key: AtomicLocalControlPlaneExecutor(operation_identity=True) with OperationIdentityAtomicAuthorityEffectDestination (one operation key row verified at the destination)

atomic_record_note: For the atomic scenarios the Control Plane run record is the one taken after the decision and before claim issuance. The Control Plane's own claim issuance (provision_local_execution_claim) opens a decision-stage journal check next to a claim-stage resolution check, and Replay refuses that record at P4 and at this generation alike (journal_check_reused); that is a finding, not changed here.
